Featuring a curved blade, the '''fi'lang''' was the traditional combat [[Knife/Legends|knife]] of the [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Trogodile/Legends|Trogodile]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the Trogodile [[Swyy'm-Ee]] wielded a pair of fi'langs during a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] [[Mission to Rattatak|match]] in [[the Cauldron]], a fighting arena on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]]. However, Swyy'm-Ee was [[Death/Legends|killed]] midway through the match by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].

==Description==
The fi'lang<ref name="Stickers" /> was a curved-blade [[Knife/Legends|combat knife]] that was augmented with a pair of sharpened points: the first at the end of the blade, and the second on the inside of the blade's curve. However, the prominence and size of the spike inside of the blade's curve varied between fi'langs. The fi'lang could be wielded with one [[Limb/Legends|hand]], allowing the user to handle a pair of the blades at the same [[Time/Legends|time]]. The [[Weapon/Legends|weapon's]] strapped [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] was [[Color/Legends|brown]], and its blade was white and light blue.<ref name="CW6" />

==History==
[[File:Flalios_Swyym-Ee.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Swyy'm-Ee, wielding fi'langs, faces off against Flalios.]]
The fi'lang was the traditional weapon of the [[Trogodile/Legends|Trogodiles]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Stickers" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The [[Mission to Rattatak]] took place between the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], which {{FactFile2014|6|22 BBY 75-80|Dark Side Influence}} dates to 22 BBY also. Therefore, the Mission to [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] must have taken place in 22 BBY as well.</ref> the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Trogodile<ref name="CW6" /> [[Swyy'm-Ee]]<ref name="Stickers" /> was forced to compete in a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] [[Mission to Rattatak|match]]<ref name="CW6" /> in [[the Cauldron]], a large fighting pit located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]].<ref name="Stickers" /> During the match, Swyy'm-Ee brandished a pair of fi'langs, and at one point, he faced off against fellow gladiator [[Flalios]]. However, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] entered the match midway and dropped a large [[Rock|boulder]] on Swyy'm-Ee using her [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Trogodile.<ref name="CW6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fi'lang first appeared, albeit unnamed, in the [[Chapter 6 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|sixth chapter]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'' animated television series. The episode originally aired on [[Cartoon Network]]<ref name="CW6" /> on [[November 15]], [[2003]].<ref name="Chapter Archive">{{SWArchive|url=clonewars/microseries/chapter/archive.html|text=View ''Clone Wars'' Chapter Archive}}</ref> The weapon was later identified as the fi'lang in the ''[[Ultimate Sticker Book: Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', published in [[2004]].<ref name="Stickers" />
